description: On desktop, each feedback overlay window (one per screen, at most eight, each named because no capability may use a wildcard; opened only by a press of the feedback shortcut) may read its own screen's still through plugin:feedback|still, hand the box the person drew to plugin:feedback|select, or end the feedback with plugin:feedback|end (HAL-18778). No command takes a capture: only the key press does. It is local only, so the Studio the computer serves gets nothing.
